basis: Official publisher aims-and-scope pages. Fit assessments are editorial inferences based on the intended empirical study, not acceptance predictions. No indexing, quartile, fee or turnaround claim has been checked.

candidates.publisher_scope_summary: Broad computer science and interdisciplinary research; the listed topics include machine learning, AI, data mining, modelling and simulation. The page describes assessment from a sound-science perspective.
candidates.fit_inference: Most plausible first CS target among the pages checked for a reproducible three-region ML evaluation with clear computational questions.
candidates.positioning: Lead with generalization, validation design, feature-set comparisons and reusable code. Regional hydrology provides the application and interpretation.
candidates.remaining_editorial_test: The manuscript still needs a clear original empirical finding and sufficient experimental evidence beyond a routine ranking of regressors.

candidates.publisher_scope_summary: Practical neural computing and related methods, including machine learning, applied statistics, benchmarks, performance measures and supervised learning. Original articles must offer new, significant research, developments or useful applications.
candidates.fit_inference: A conditional applied-ML candidate if the final experiments produce a substantial generalization result; a small routine comparison may be weak.
candidates.positioning: Emphasize what regional holdouts reveal about model behaviour and when predictor sets help or harm transfer.
candidates.remaining_editorial_test: Benchmark breadth, repeatability and the significance of the contribution need a manuscript-level assessment. Its name is not a reason to add an unjustified neural model.

candidates.publisher_scope_summary: Formal and computational methods, spatial and temporal analysis and computer applications in Earth systems. Its current guidance requires the principal contribution to be Earth science informatics; predominantly meteorological, geographic or routine application work may be outside scope.
candidates.fit_inference: An interdisciplinary computing alternative if the paper's main result concerns an auditable modelling and evaluation workflow.
candidates.positioning: Demonstrate how the computational design supports reliable regional transfer assessment and reproducibility.
candidates.remaining_editorial_test: A manuscript mainly describing regional soil moisture, with ML as a routine tool, may not satisfy the explicit informatics focus.

checked_but_not_prioritized.publisher_scope_summary: The scope emphasizes new intelligent-system methodologies and explicitly distinguishes original technological developments from applying existing technologies to different datasets.
checked_but_not_prioritized.fit_inference: Do not prioritize the proposed standard-regressor comparison here without a genuine methodological contribution.
